text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm at the Fan Fest because I heard Mejiro McQueen was going to be at one of the events.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's our hugely popular segment, "What's in the Box?"! And our next contestant is… right here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. How are you doing today?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A member of the noble Mejiro family, it's Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Loads of people have expressed their desire to see a high-class Umamusume's reactions! Can you live up to their expectations?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Easily. No matter what happens, I shall handle it in a calm, composed manner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Urgh! I know this is what the fans voted for, but why would they choose such an absurd event?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (So many other events are available and far more respectable than this one!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Right then, let's get started! Brrring out the box!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Ahh, gracious me! Anything could happen now!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, it's so cold! What on earth is this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is it alive?! There is no way you would put a living creature in here, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen continues feeling inside the box for a little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-it's no use, I can't do this! I don't care that everyone voted for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please! Please, this once! Have mercy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're hopeless, huh? I can't believe konjac jelly got you this shook up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha… Konjac jelly?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That was a splendid spectacle, though! The way the jelly made this young noble dance sure was something!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thanks for watching, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: K-konjac…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was in a panic… over konjac jelly?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …That night, Mejiro McQueen has a dream about being chased by a giant ball of konjac.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: It's okay! Don't be scared!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: E-everyone…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (That's right… The fans came here especially to see me!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I will not be made the fool!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rrrrrr… There!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: O-oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Could this be… konjac jelly?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh! You. Are. CORRECT! Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew, thank goodness…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what did you think? That was magnificent, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, great job figuring out what it was.
Yeah, great job figuring out what it was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I was afraid at first because I thought it was alive, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then I heard the supportive cheers of my fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Once I decisively strengthened my grip, the answer came easier than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm reminded again that the path forward is opened by tackling challenges fearlessly.
choice_data_list: You have the fans to thank for that.
You have the fans to thank for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. I'm grateful to everyone for always cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …That night, Mejiro McQueen enjoys a dish made with konjac as she reflects on her gratitude towards her fans.
